T-151 is in review: the intake service works and the PR is open, but the triage agent scored 83% on the 30 real reports, short of the 90% target.

decisions.decision: Build T-151 end to end now. 1) Read docs/onboarding-v3/analysis/integrations-tantra-api.md. Clone Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2 (branch development) and Usetantra/tantra-mcp into ~/tantra-feedback-work, outside every project repo. 2) Build a local intake service (Claude-written code, no n8n or Make) with one queue table. It takes three inputs: the in-app widget, a public form and a team-channel adapter. Reject any report missing type, brand/workspace, reporter, severity, steps or attachment. 3) Build the triage agent: labels bug or feature, merges duplicates, sets severity, routes to T-152 or T-153. Score it on 30 real reports taken from Usetantra GitHub issues and Adi's session transcripts; target 90% or better. 4) Send acknowledgement and shipped emails only to [email] ('Adi test'). 5) Write the one-page how-to-report guide in Backlinko voice. 6) Put the widget and guide link on a feature branch, open a PR to development and request Bharath's review. Do not merge.
decisions.why: Spec says Claude builds it end to end (voice notes 2026-09-25/26). Bharath's sign-off is a team review, not an input from Adi. Rules owner-launch-constraints (no n8n, run locally) and owner-decisions-2026-10-06 (test identity) apply. No work started; due date passed.

decisions.decision: Close the triage gap; do not lower the 90% target. 1) Write a labelling rubric in workshop-plan/feedback-intake: bug vs feature, severity levels copied from docs/bug-pipeline/severity.md, and a duplicate rule. 2) Relabel the existing 30 reports by that rubric and keep them as the tuning set. 3) Collect a fresh held-out set of 30 real reports (session transcripts, the T-152 audit bugs behind PRs 160 to 164, T-153 seed requests, team notes) and label them by the rubric before running the agent. 4) Improve the agent: put the severity rubric in the prompt and use T-153's reqstore BM25 match for duplicates. 5) Score on the held-out set; pass is 27/30 or better. Log both scores and every miss honestly; iterate on the tuning set only. 6) Commit and push, then re-request Bharath's review on PR 166. Do not merge. Leave the task in review.
decisions.why: T-151 log 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-11: triage 25/30 (83%) misses the 90% done-when; the prompt was tuned on that same batch, so a held-out batch is needed. Bharath's sign-off is a team review, not an Adi input (orchestrator-autonomy).
